admits_nothing.detail: No manifest on main carries t1_live_db_precondition and nothing in this repository writes it, so G6 reports skip on every existing lane. resolveVerdict in scripts/ops/preflight.ts is untouched, so blocked_by_containment still resolves to INFRA and no lane opens that could not open before.
admits_nothing.significance: This lane adds a fail-closed obligation. The admission change that would activate it is written out as an exact diff in PT1_CONTAINMENT_ADMISSION_DECISION.md section 6a and deliberately not applied; it is reserved to PM under intent.md 'Changes to the operating model'.

not_routable_around.detail: G6 is evaluated after the G1-G4 block. Both earlier exits that skip it are hard returns that cannot produce a passing verdict: no GitHub token returns verdict infra_error with exit 3, and no pr_url returns verdict fail with exit 1. A lane carrying the field therefore cannot reach a pass without G6 having run.
not_routable_around.significance: Placement was read from the enclosing control flow rather than assumed, because a check wired after a soft continue would be a fail-open.

receipt_contexts_asserted_directly.detail: T1_DEFERRAL_RECEIPT_CONTEXTS names both 'verify' and 'Writable DB proof (staging only)'. verify already declares needs: staging-db-proof with an explicit fail-closed guard in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so asserting verify alone would arguably suffice — but that is an inference about workflow wiring, and a later edit loosening the needs: relationship must not be able to silently satisfy this gate.
receipt_contexts_asserted_directly.significance: The passing test asserts the detail string names every context, so a context silently dropped from the constant fails the test rather than quietly narrowing the receipt.

reserved_surface_untouched.significance: No workflow changed. No CODEOWNERS change, no branch-protection change, no tier semantics, no approval artifact, and no change to what verify requires.

real_manifest_inertness.observed: 752 manifests read from docs/06_status/lanes/, 0 carrying t1_live_db_precondition, 736 validated with 0 errors attributable to the field, 16 skipped.
real_manifest_inertness.significance: The issue's acceptance criterion 1 requires this against a real existing manifest rather than a fixture. The carriers==0 assertion doubles as a tripwire: if it ever fails, the reserved admission half was applied and G6 is live rather than inert.
real_manifest_inertness.honest_reading: The 16 skipped are closed lanes whose worktree_path is null, on which validateManifest throws from isPortableAbsolutePath. That is a pre-existing defect unrelated to this field and outside this lane scope; they are counted and skipped rather than swallowed, and the test refuses to pass vacuously if the validated count is zero.

runtime_proof.detail: Static-proof governance lane. It adds a manifest field, its validation rules and one closeout check. The evaluator is pure — it takes the manifest field, the merge SHA and a CommitCheckResult as arguments — and the lane adds no database access of its own.

known_gaps: G6 has never fired on a real lane and cannot have: no manifest carries t1_live_db_precondition. Every claim about its behaviour comes from direct invocation of the evaluator with constructed inputs, plus a source assertion that it is wired into the run.

The admission half of PT1_CONTAINMENT_ADMISSION_DECISION Part 2 -- whether blocked_by_containment may issue a preflight token for a T1 lane -- remains unapplied and reserved. This lane does not unblock UTV2-1842; route A0 or route B in section 5 of that document does, and both are the owner's decision.

The fetchCommitChecks call that supplies G6's receipt input is exercised only through the evaluator's injected argument, not end-to-end against GitHub. The catch that maps a throw to null is asserted by the unreadable-checks test on the evaluator side; the network call itself is not covered by a new test.

validateManifest throws (not returns an error) on a manifest whose worktree_path is null, from isPortableAbsolutePath at scripts/ops/shared.ts:1884. 16 of the 752 manifests on this branch are in that state. Found while writing the acceptance-criterion-1 test; pre-existing, unrelated to this field, and deliberately not repaired here -- this lane file_scope_lock covers shared.ts, but the repair changes validation behaviour for every closed lane and belongs in its own reviewed change.
